interactionSteps.note: Focus does not move to the field.

title: Error summary links to an element that does not exist
description: The error summary link points at #date-a-field, but the input's id is date-a. Activating the link does nothing, so the summary cannot be used to reach the field.

relatedElements.note: Does not exist in the document.
Links to the real field id.

expectedBehaviour: Each error summary link moves focus to the field that needs correcting.
actualBehaviour: The link's fragment does not match any element id, so activating it has no effect.
userImpact: People who rely on the summary to navigate errors cannot reach the field and must search the page.

observed.note: Page-level axe run with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and best-practice. No violation was reported for this page in its default state; the control on the same page also passes.

detection.note: No WCAG failure is claimed: the error is still identified in text. The defect is an inoperative recovery link.

manualTests: Submit the empty form and activate the error summary link. Check whether focus moves to the field.

assertions: #date-a-field has no matching element; the input id is #date-a.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps variant A errors unassociated, unfocused and linked to nothing

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
